situations.name: The inherited mess
situations.summary: A backlog nobody has worked, a register nobody believes, and an organisation that has not been badly hurt yet. The year as it usually begins.

situations.name: After the breach
situations.summary: Your predecessor left after ransomware encrypted fulfilment last quarter. There is emergency money and a board that no longer trusts reassurance, and the people who got in know the way back.

setupEffects.reason: Last quarter's breach surprised the board, and it has not forgotten.

situations.name: New money, short patience
situations.summary: The board has doubled down on cyber after a peer's bad year. The money is real, and so is the expectation that it shows by the autumn.

setupEffects.reason: He argued against the budget increase and lost.

setupEffects.concern: Whether the extra cyber budget shows a return
Visible progress for the new money

situations.name: A tidy inheritance
situations.summary: Your predecessor was good. The controls are better than most, the board is comfortable, and the budget has been trimmed because it all seems fine.

setupEffects.reason: Your predecessor's reports were trusted, and some of that passed to you.
